entries.en: It doesn't look like[n]it's going to open...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Guess this wall's a no-go unless we can[n]get more people to accept us...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, can't you just use your Oracle power[n]or whatever to do something about it?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Prolly not. I'm not some kinda god,[n]you know?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Speaking of gods... have you heard of the[n]god who performed a lewd dance to open[n]a sealed rock door?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hmmm... I think I see what you're[n]getting at. Go for it, Skull!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We can now expand the range of our[n]exploration.
